repair: At most one confirmed editorial repair, with request IDs reused for uncertain attempts.
source_rule: Read-only company store: registered enabled use_for_summary articles with matching source digest, nonempty content, source publication and collection before exact cutoff, 30-hour publication window, per-origin 48 and global 600 bounds. No retrospective web, current data-lake or search backfill. At most 96 frozen candidates, validated plan at most 16 and 42000 source characters.

One offline edition cannot qualify live timing or Slack delivery.
stop_on_unavailable: If the original snapshot has no eligible closing reports or too little coverage, mark unavailable without substituting later sources or claiming quality.
offline_scope: Historical source read-only; no Slack send, deployment, database mutation or paid API call.
